title: Schnetz's prime reduction conjecture for $c_2$ invariants
statement:
Let $G_1$ and $G_2$ be graphs, and for a prime power $q=p^s$ let $c_2^{(q)}(G)$ denote their $c_2$ invariants. **Schnetz's prime reduction conjecture.** If

$$
c_2^{(p)}(G_1)\equiv c_2^{(p)}(G_2)\pmod p
$$

for every prime $p$, then

$$
c_2^{(q)}(G_1)\equiv c_2^{(q)}(G_2)\pmod q
$$

for every prime power $q=p^s$. The conjecture would reduce comparisons of $c_2$ invariants at all prime powers to comparisons at primes. The source attributes this conjecture to Oliver Schnetz and presents it as an open question.
source_name: Maria S. Esipova and Karen Yeats, “A result on the c_2 invariant for powers of primes”, arXiv:2206.06835 (2023).
references:
Source: https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.06835

Status: no resolution is reported in the source (as of June 2022).
